name: South East Technological University
description:
South East Technological University (SETU) is a leading institution in Waterford, Ireland.

The university offers programmes in business, engineering, science, health sciences, education and humanities. 

Ranked as the 7th best higher education body in Ireland by Webometrics, it has five distinct campuses.

A strong co-curricular offering, including sports, arts and travel is also available to students to help enrich their learning.

International students benefit from a range of tailored facilities. SETU's International Student Services provide dedicated assistance with academic queries, visa concerns, and cultural adaptation. The university's Language Excellence Program supports non-native English speakers through specialised language programs and tutoring services. SETU also offers the International Student Lounge and the Cultural Exchange Center to celebrate its considerable commitment to diversity. For fitness and recreation, the campus features the Wellness Center.

Student Life

Student life is made easy with the wide variety of student support services at the university. From peer mentoring to help with academic success to student counselling to ease any personal issues, international students are fully supported by the university. Student clubs include the African Caribbean Society, Engineers without Borders and the TableTop Gaming Society, bringing a diverse mix of interests to the forefront of university life. highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value: At South East Technological University (SETU), a variety of accommodation options are offered to international students. Accommodation at the college campus consists of 66 single en-suite rooms, equipped with modern amenities like Wi-Fi, laundry facilities, resident parking, CCTV surveillance, 24 hour security and common areas. SETU collaborates with local housing providers to offer off-campus housing alternatives and the university's international student services team assists students in finding suitable housing options in the nearby area. City campus accommodation is situated only 15 minutes away for students who prefer a more independent living environment, with 94 apartments and 360 bed spaces.
